title.narrative: PoultryTechBangladesh_2021-2025

description.narrative: Larive International, in close cooperation with its partner office in Bangladesh, LightCastle Partners, coordinate the project. This includes coordinating all activities according to pre-agreed goals and timelines, stakeholder communication, identifying needs and managing expectations of cluster partners, stakeholders in Bangladesh, NEA and the EKN in Dhaka, reporting on project progress, taking care of financial and administrative compliance, providing local support/liaison in Bangladesh and coordinating and communicating with collaboration partners.

Main objectives PoultryTechBangladesh - Support Bangladesh’s poultry sector to become more competitive (e.g. improve productivity), more sustainable (more effective usage of inputs, less impact on the environment and improved animal welfare) and more responsible. - Trigger and support entrepreneurship and share values about integer business practices. - Identify, assess and stimulate business activities and partnerships between stakeholders active in the Dutch and Bangladeshi poultry value chains, resulting in increased trade (import/export), investment and (international) co-operations.

Project members. Bangladeshi investors in the poultry sector. Bangladeshi farmers, farm managers, operators and supervisors active in the poultry industry. Dutch companies active in the poultry sector willing to become active in the Bangladeshi market. EKN. NEA.
